//: Mad Max-toned looks for the in-world POC (P1-U05.5, R108, POC2-09): one scene, switched live (the bar on the page, or &look=<id>). light: sun azimuth/elevation in degrees (azimuth 0 = +z, the cast shadow falls away from it), colour and intensity; the hemisphere ambient's sky and ground colours (the toon model's image-based light: r182's toon material ignores scene.environment); fog; tone mapping and exposure. sky: the painted sky's gradient and cloud colours. grade (shaders/pipeline.js): split tone as linear RGB multipliers for the shadows and the highlights, blended by split; contrast round mid grey; saturation; highlight bleach; vignette; grain; dust haze by view depth; heat shimmer (pixels, big tiles only). ground: the skill's grit, sun-bleach and dust. wear: damage creep (rust and scorch on paint texels) on every car without damage of its own. The recommended look is first; round1 is the look the owner reviewed in round 1, for comparison.

inkScale.//: P1-U05 br-dim.11: ink that scales with the car's on-screen size (data, R90; shaders/pipeline.js 'outer'). A car's projected size in device px = carSizeM * focalPx / z. At or above fullPx the tuned full-size width applies unchanged; below it the width falls in proportion, floored at minPx (device px); the line's alpha fades from 1 at fadeHiPx to fadeFloor at fadeLoPx; below outsideBelowPx the line is drawn on the background side only, so it never covers the body colour. enabled: the default for ?inkscale=.

settingDecisions.//: P1-U05 br-dim.12 A/B compare decisions (art/ui/poc/world/compare.js; evidence docs/evidence/br-dim.12/decisions.md). Numbers: mean abs diff 0-255 over scene pixels / % of scene pixels changed by more than 12; same frozen frame, grain and shimmer off; control A=B reads 0.

gtao.reason: No benefit seen at any size; it adds artifacts: it blackens the guard rail and stripes the distant mesas. Single-view only (never runs in a grid, so the owner's ao=1 on #grid&n=24 was a no-op).

smaa.reason: Only softens stair-steps on edges (changes 1.8% of pixels on a big tile, 7.5% in a 24 grid); not visible at 1:1, only in the 4x crop. Default AA stays (FXAA at 4 tiles or fewer, none in a grid where the outlines carry edges). ?smaa=1 stays for the compare page; grid edge AA is P1-R10 (TAA).

shadows.reason: Visible, named benefit at every size: the cast shadow grounds the cars and the halftone dots in it are the comic look (they key on the shadow). Without them the cars float on a flat ground. Shadow default is unchanged (the recommended preset runs PCF 4096; the owner's review URL passed shadow=off).

looks.name: Fury road
looks.why: Recommended. Low, harsh sun with long shadows; teal shadows against hot orange light; dust haze takes the distance; strong but readable, and identity colours stay vivid.

looks.name: Dust storm
looks.why: A soft orange world with short sight-lines: the haze closes in, shadows go soft and cars pop out of the dust.

looks.name: Bleached heat
looks.why: Noon: the sun nearly overhead, short hard shadows, glare bleaching the highlights and the far road shimmering in the heat; the paint stays readable.

looks.name: Scavenged
looks.why: Gritty and hard-edged: desaturated, high contrast, every car's paint worn back to rust at the edges, coarse grain.

looks.name: Burnt dusk
looks.why: The sun on the horizon throws long orange light; the shadows go deep teal; the emissives (lights, flares, beacons) start to matter.

looks.name: Round 1 (for comparison)
looks.why: The look the owner reviewed in round 1: the skill's day rig and warm grade, no haze or split tone.
